newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy falls on deliveries, Nov breaks support.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy falls on deliveries, Nov breaks support.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures dropped early on heavier-than-expected delivery notices posted Thursday on the November contract, traders said.
The delivery tally at 3.4 million bushels was above trader expectations for one to two million and there were scattered stoppers of the deliveries.
Nearby November broke below support at the $6.86 per bushel level. The next support level is $6.75, technical traders said.
At 0953 CDT, soybeans were five to eight cents per bushel lower, with November down eight at $6.81-1/2.
